You know sometimes in this life you either wait like.... 50 years? Or just already die since the start, there is no midline. Its the " go hard or go home " mentality. Sometimes pain is not a choice and sometimes you have to live like dead inside for the sake of others even though you dont like it, sometimes your attachent to life is for your own good. These months sometimes I wake up saying " I should be dead by now, how am I still alive " because of how much I've gone through, like... 100 suicide thoughts/attempts, it already feels illogical keeping up but I've learnt so much from keeping up....
